body:
THEY ARE HERS. Not a Silken Embrace innovation, not a Concierge's clever answer to a customer request — SERAPHINE CAMILLA VARGAS MADE THEM, wore them to work once, and the shop came along afterward.

AND THE ORIGINAL DESIGN PURPOSE WAS NOT THE BATHROOM. The engineered fly exists so that Sera can get her cock out of a thong FAST, one-handed, without undoing anything — because Sera loses her entire mind when Bella bends over, and Bella bends over constantly, and the gap between those two facts was measured in seconds Sera did not want to spend. The bathroom access is a genuine benefit and it is a SIDE EFFECT. The primary function is the easy fishing-out manoeuvre.

MEGAN SAW THEM AND ISSUED A RULING. Sera's boss at the Lucky Hammer is a voyeur and has never pretended otherwise, and what she said was: THAT. ALL OF OUR AFFIRMED EMPLOYEES. One garment, one look, and it became the uniform — which means an entire bar's affirmed staff now work in shorts designed around one woman's reaction time to her own wife.

WHAT SILKEN EMBRACE DID was manufacture them properly: engineered fly structure, full coverage while wearing panties, back pockets placed to the wearer's own lower-body geometry, stretch denim that still reads as real denim. They sell in every branch now.

THE SHOP'S OWN GUIDE TELLS IT DIFFERENTLY, and the difference is worth keeping. Its version has Sera arriving as a customer, mentioning a gap half-joking, and the store inventing the product two weeks later and gifting her the first pair with a thank-you note. THE CREDIT DRIFTS TOWARD THE INSTITUTION, which is what company histories do. The thank-you note is probably real. The invention is not theirs.
